title: LCH-02 launch execution contract (repository-only template)
description: Repository-only LCH-02 launch execution contract (PLAN.md section 8 LCH-02). Fillable foundation only: nothing is deployed, no launch session exists, no on-call is active, no dashboard is monitored, and rollback authority is PENDING. This fixture is a template — it does not claim deployment, a first session, or production readiness. The Phase 11 DEP-06 release record (infra/deployment-contracts/release-record.example.json) is the release state machine instance and stays prepared; this contract references it and does not fork it. It does not modify or duplicate config/current-state.json, which remains the authoritative source of truth (0/17 gates complete, 0/14 phases accepted, production pre-production, dataStage synthetic-only, scope browser-only).

authority.note: current-state remains the authoritative manifest; this contract never overrides it. Phase 12 references the Phase 11 DEP-06 release state machine and validator; rollback compatibility is checked against the repository migrations registry only, with no invented live target.

stateMachine.allowedTransitions: prepared → staging_verified → canary_observing → promote_pending → promoted | rollback_required → rolled_back | aborted

evidence.note: Repository-only fixture; no authentic external evidence exists and none is claimed. No evidence path, session identifier, or monitoring endpoint is recorded.
